hooks.text: 用全局冷却、技能时机、装备效果和团队机制处理，浓缩复刻高难MMO团本。
hooks.excerpt: Combat is deliberately similar to tab-target MMORPGs, being based around global cooldowns, effective skill usage, gear effects, and resolving boss mechanics through teamwork.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 1至4只兔子可共同出征，单人时原本需要协作的机制会替换成高强度弹幕。
hooks.excerpt: Anywhere from 1 to 4 rabbits can embark together. If you venture out alone, mechanics that normally require cooperation will be replaced with intense bullet hell attacks.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 随机战利品之间存在强力套装组合，还会制造队友争抢关键装备的团本趣味。
hooks.excerpt: Certain sets of items combo very well together... so make sure your allies don't roll on something you really need!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
